sources.summary:
Title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
Final URL: https://openai.com/index/advancing-chip-design-with-our-models/
OpenAI’s models are quickly improving the chips that power AI. [In August,⁠](https://openai.com/index/jalapeno-first-results/) we shared how OpenAI engineers used our frontier models to accelerate the development of our first custom inference chip, Jalapeño. Here, we look more closely at the expert-level design improvements behind the Jalapeño gains and how we’re applying th
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI披露GPT-4o助Jalapeño将vector unit标准单元面积减约13%、matrix unit减约10%，与AMD合作在旗舰GPU IP上实现最高14% PPA提升，不到5个月取得约一年进展。

en.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
en.reason: OpenAI’s GPT-4o helped Jalapeño cut vector-unit standard-cell area by about 13% and matrix-unit area by about 10%, while work with AMD on flagship GPU IP delivered up to 14% PPA gains in under five months.

items.title: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久 / Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say

sources.title: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久 / Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.title_zh: 为什么你的微调任务比FLOPs算出来的还要久
sources.title_en: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.title_original: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章用272个真实SFT任务对比：FLOP估算仅R²=0.31、MAE 12.41 h，仅用调度前信息的CatBoost达R²=0.98、MAE 1.71 h，解释微调为何常超FLOPs预期。

en.reason: Across 272 production SFT runs, FLOP-based estimates reached only R²=0.31 and 12.41 h MAE, while CatBoost using pre-scheduling information hit R²=0.98 and 1.71 h MAE, explaining why fine-tuning often outruns FLOP predictions.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Apache 2.0 开源的 0.5B Rumble-2-Flash 支持 40+ 语言，在多语种测试中平均错误率 6.96%，优于大 15 倍的 Meta omniASR-LLM 7B。

en.reason: Rumble-2-Flash is a 0.5B-parameter Apache 2.0 speech recognition model covering 40+ languages, with a 6.96% average error rate on multilingual tests that beats Meta's 15x larger omniASR-LLM 7B and rivals models 3-60x its size.
